title: Releasing mouse after scrubbing in style panel selects style in different section
reason: Reports cross-section selection when releasing a style scrub in a different panel section, despite cross-section scrubbing itself being disallowed. No discussion or local reproduction evidence was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential real interaction regression; no Varve style-panel reproduction was performed.

title: Workspace switcher dropdown auto-dismisses when reopened during a workspace switch
reason: Describes a transient dropdown dismiss during asynchronous tldraw.com workspace/file switching. The sole comment links a video; the attachment was not independently replayed.

varveAssessment.assessment: Workspace switching is upstream dotcom behavior and no Varve reproduction was performed.

title: Undo after duplicating a shape reverts the prior label edit instead of the duplication
reason: Reports that duplicating immediately after finishing a shape-label edit fails to create a history stopping point. The only reply says maintainers could not reproduce it.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an important undo-history regression lead, but no Varve repro or local history inspection has been done.

title: Escape does not end the editing interaction while editing a shape
reason: Reports Escape failing to leave label, text, or note editing. The only reply asks for details because maintainers could not reproduce it.

varveAssessment.assessment: Treat as a candidate keyboard-navigation regression test only after local reproduction.

title: Minimap click easing animation behaviour inconsistent
reason: The only comment confirms the inconsistent minimap animation was fixed in #9305.

varveAssessment.assessment: The upstream fix is not evidence of an analogous Varve defect.

title: Draw tool causes full browser engine crash for iOS 18.2 -> 18.3.2
reason: Maintainer attributes the reported crash to an iOS WebKit issue fixed in 18.4+, while noting no stack trace establishes whether draw compression contributed. The platform boundary and uncertain causal link are preserved.

varveAssessment.assessment: Requires affected iOS versions and device testing; no Varve platform reproduction was performed.

title: Match end-shape scales if arrow is created between two existing shapes
reason: Requests consistent arrow endpoint scale when creating arrows between differently sized existing shapes. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve behavior or user preference was inspected; this is an upstream feature idea.

title: Add a border prop to image and video shapes
reason: Requests persistent border style variants for media shapes. Comments support exploration and point to a PR/playground rather than establishing a settled design or shipped behavior.

varveAssessment.assessment: This feature would require a Varve-specific design and serialization decision; no change is justified from the upstream proposal alone.

title: Allow editing the display name from the tldraw.com sidebar
reason: Requests editing the account name shown in the upstream sidebar after OAuth sign-in. This depends on upstream account identity/profile services; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not ship the upstream account/sidebar service; no marketing-site change is indicated.

title: Canvas background flashes before the loading spinner appears when creating a new file
reason: Reports that a newly created upstream file shows an uninitialized canvas before its loading indicator during asynchronous document loading. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's loading shell has separate architecture; a local defect must be tested against its own loading lifecycle.
